data.one_liner: An input field that controls virtual keyboard visibility without losing focus.
data.what_it_does: The package provides a customizable input widget that allows developers to control whether the on-screen keyboard appears or stays hidden while keeping focus on the input field. It is designed specifically for hardware or external barcode scanner integrations.
use_when: You are building an app that uses a hardware barcode scanner and need the input to retain focus without popping up the software keyboard.
You need a text field with a built-in toggle button to show or hide the keyboard.
avoid_when: You are looking for a complete barcode scanning library using the device camera.
You need standard text input behavior without keyboard visibility control.
strengths: Keeps input focus while suppressing the software keyboard
Includes customizable parameters for button colors, underlines, and keyboard states
weaknesses: Limited to a single specific input control use case
Relatively old package with no recent updates post null-safety transition
data.minimal_example:
InputWithKeyboardControl(
  focusNode: InputWithKeyboardControlFocusNode(),
  onSubmitted: (value) {
    print(value);
  },
  autofocus: true,
  controller: TextEditingController(),
  width: 300,
  startShowKeyboard: false,
  buttonColorEnabled: Colors.blue,
  buttonColorDisabled: Colors.black,
  underlineColor: Colors.black,
  showUnderline: true,
  showButton: true,
)
